column4: Location listing has key input and unknown security without affirmative unrestricted access.
Zone audit changes have API-key security but no caller-zone authorization relationship.
API-definition update has only action/key/status fields and no explicit caller privilege.
Refresh-token invalidation has unknown security and no token-owner lookup.
Invitation user, group and inviter fields do not select a verified authorized caller.
Comment user is inferred without explicit owner-only editing or verified binding.
Event owner_id is an inferred hint with no verified key or specified update policy.
Map owner_id and visibility lack verified caller ownership semantics.
Collaborator is_admin describes a member, not the caller's required role or bypass.
Maintenance companyId is inferred and api-public path does not establish unrestricted access.
Override team and user assignments are objects being changed, not verified authorization rules.
User contact-device deletion lacks owner fields or verified user-contact lookup.
Contact-email deletion has user path context but no verified ownership relation.
Contact-phone retrieval has user context without a verified caller-subject binding.
Classifier deletion has accessKey and secretKey inputs but no specified caller ownership rule.
Order customer contact fields describe shipping data rather than a verified caller-owner relationship.
Site backup canBackup flag is resource data, not caller authorization or verified ownership.
Site-extension retrieval has unknown security and no caller-site binding.
Site tag mutation has admin_url and capability fields without explicit caller roles or ownership.
Weather alerts require a key parameter and no affirmative unrestricted API-access statement.
Air-quality forecast has key input and unknown security, not explicit public authorization.
Competition isPublished describes data visibility rather than unrestricted API access.
Article-review summaries have unknown security and only pagination/content wrappers.
Category hidden flag implies variable visibility and no affirmative unrestricted-access evidence.
Marking a message read lacks verified recipient or owner lookup and specified security.
Voice-message recipient number is contact data, not a verified caller authorization binding.
